findings.issue: Home loader filtering (humanized case-insensitive search, type-in-either-slot, generation membership), 48-per-page pagination and page clamping have no tests
findings.suggestion: Add loader-level unit tests against fixture API data: filter combinations, boundary pages (first/last/out-of-range/NaN page), and the zero-match case

findings.issue: The lastPushed-ref/150ms-debounce URL-sync state machine is the subtlest logic in the app and is untested; races between typing, Enter-submit and back/forward will regress silently
findings.suggestion: Write a component test that types, navigates back, and types again, asserting the input value and URL stay in sync

findings.issue: cardsFromPokemon (id>10000 exclusion, species-index dedupe, dex ordering) backs the move/ability/type lists and is untested
findings.suggestion: Unit test with refs including alternate forms (>10000), duplicates and unknown IDs; this is pure and trivially testable

findings.issue: Bidirectional missing-values-last sorting, direction flip, tie-breaks and aria-sort placement are untested
findings.suggestion: Test each sortable column asc/desc with null power/accuracy rows, asserting order and aria-sort on the right header only

findings.issue: Moves grouping — version-group ordering by order, default-to-highest-order game, METHOD_ORDER-with-Infinity comparator, and the move|method|level dedupe key — is untested
findings.suggestion: Unit test the grouping/ordering with a fabricated pokemon payload covering known and unknown methods

findings.issue: latestEnglishFlavorText ('last en entry', whitespace/\f collapse) and englishName fallbacks are untested pure functions
findings.suggestion: Straightforward unit tests with multi-language entries and \f-laden flavor text

findings.issue: Error-path discrimination (404 vs 'Something went wrong') and non-404 API failures are untested; only a single 404 URL is verified by acceptance
findings.suggestion: Test the ErrorBoundary with a 404 data response and a thrown Error, plus getRecord with an invalid name (regex guard at api.server.ts:45)

findings.issue: In-memory cache (TTL, promise dedupe, rejection eviction, unbounded Map with expired entries never deleted) is untested
findings.suggestion: Test that a rejected fetch isn't served to a second concurrent caller and evicts correctly; consider pruning expired entries on access

findings.issue: queryFor's default-omission contract (page<=1 and empty values omitted from the URL) is untested
findings.suggestion: Unit test queryFor directly for round-tripping filters and page defaults

findings.issue: Height/weight formatting ((x/10).toFixed(1)) and orDash em-dash rendering for null power/accuracy are untested
findings.suggestion: Cheap unit tests alongside format.ts helpers

summary: The agent wrote no tests at all: no test script, runner, or spec files exist in app/, leaving every risky transformation — home filtering/pagination, URL-state sync, card dedupe, move-table sorting, localization and error paths — guarded only by the sample-based acceptance suite. The pure helpers in lib/format.ts and lib/api.server.ts were ideal unit-test targets, so the omission is a choice, not a difficulty. Once someone refactors the data layer, most regressions here would ship unnoticed.
